morning.he: מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם, שֶׁהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה, רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ.
morning.en: I give thanks before You, living and enduring King, for returning my soul to me with compassion; great is Your faithfulness.
morning.reflect: Name one thing you are thankful to wake up to.
morning.source: Traditional morning liturgy (Modeh Ani); anonymous medieval text, public domain; verify against lane 5 registry
morning.heFemale: מוֹדָה אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם, שֶׁהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה, רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ.
morning.unlockNote: Shown as transliteration-free audio card until lesson r39 (Modeh Ani) is decoded.

morning.he: זֶה הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְהוָה, נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ.
morning.en: This is the day the Eternal made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
morning.reflect: What is one thing you want to enjoy today?

morning.he: לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע, וְנָבִא לְבַב חָכְמָה.
morning.en: Teach us to count our days so that we may gain a wise heart.
morning.reflect: What one thing will matter by tonight?

morning.en: Eternal One, in the morning You hear my voice.
morning.reflect: What do you want to say out loud this morning?

morning.he: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיהוָה, וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן.
morning.en: It is good to give thanks to the Eternal and to sing to Your name.
morning.reflect: Sing or hum one line before you leave the house.

morning.en: Let me hear Your kindness in the morning.
morning.reflect: Where will you look for kindness today?

morning.en: ...and with the morning, a ringing joy.
morning.reflect: What would a good morning sound like?

morning.en: New every morning; great is Your faithfulness.
morning.reflect: What is new today, even if small?

morning.he: עֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד וְהַצְנֵעַ לֶכֶת עִם אֱלֹהֶיךָ.
morning.en: To do justice, to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God.
morning.reflect: Which of the three will you practice first today?

morning.he: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב, בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ.
morning.en: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
morning.reflect: Who could you make peace with today?

morning.he: בְּכָל דְּרָכֶיךָ דָעֵהוּ, וְהוּא יְיַשֵּׁר אֹרְחֹתֶיךָ.
morning.en: In all your ways know Him, and He will make your paths straight.
morning.reflect: What path are you on this week?

morning.en: May the Eternal bless you and keep you.
morning.reflect: Whisper this blessing to someone or to yourself.

morning.he: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב, כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ.
morning.en: Give thanks to the Eternal, for He is good; His kindness is forever.

morning.he: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים יְהִי אוֹר, וַיְהִי אוֹר.
morning.en: God said, 'Let there be light,' and there was light.
morning.reflect: Open a window or turn on a light on purpose and notice it.
How can the work in front of you be done gladly?

evening.he: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהוָה אֶחָד.
evening.en: Hear, O Israel: the Eternal is our God, the Eternal is One.
evening.reflect: Say it slowly once, covering your eyes if you wish.
evening.unlockNote: Unlocks after the Shema is decoded (lesson r22); the night-time Shema prompt.

evening.en: In peace I will lie down and sleep.
evening.reflect: What can you put down before bed?

evening.he: הִנֵּה לֹא יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל.
evening.en: Behold, the Guardian of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps.
evening.reflect: What are you handing over for the night?

evening.he: יְהוָה יִשְׁמָר צֵאתְךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם.
evening.en: The Eternal will guard your going out and your coming in, now and forever.
evening.reflect: Where did you go today, and who did you meet?

evening.he: יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן, בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן.
evening.en: One who dwells in the shelter of the Most High abides in the shadow of the Almighty.
evening.reflect: Where did you feel safe today?

evening.en: To tell of Your kindness in the morning and Your faithfulness in the nights.
evening.reflect: Name one kindness you saw today.

evening.he: וַיְהִי עֶרֶב וַיְהִי בֹקֶר, יוֹם אֶחָד.
evening.en: There was evening and there was morning, one day.
evening.reflect: What is finished? What carries over?

evening.he: כִּי אֶרְאֶה שָׁמֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂה אֶצְבְּעֹתֶיךָ, יָרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים אֲשֶׁר כּוֹנָנְתָּה.
evening.en: When I see Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars You set in place...
evening.reflect: Step outside and look up for one minute.

evening.en: The heavens tell the glory of God.
evening.reflect: What did you notice in the sky or outdoors today?

evening.he: גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת, לֹא אִירָא רָע, כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי.
evening.en: Even if I walk through the valley of deepest darkness, I fear no evil, for You are with me.
evening.reflect: What are you worried about, and what helps?

evening.he: אֲנִי שָׁכַבְתִּי וָאִישָׁנָה, הֱקִיצוֹתִי כִּי יְהוָה יִסְמְכֵנִי.
evening.en: I lay down and slept; I awoke, for the Eternal sustains me.
evening.reflect: What is one thing you trust will be there tomorrow?

evening.he: יִשָּׂא יְהוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם.
evening.en: May the Eternal lift His face to you and grant you peace.
evening.reflect: Whisper this to end the day.

evening.he: יְהוָה עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן, יְהוָה יְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם.
evening.en: The Eternal gives strength to His people; the Eternal blesses His people with peace.

evening.he: הִנֵּה בָּרְכוּ אֶת יְהוָה כָּל עַבְדֵי יְהוָה, הָעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בַּלֵּילוֹת.
evening.en: Come, bless the Eternal, all servants of the Eternal who stand in the house of the Eternal by night.
evening.reflect: What would you say in thanks before sleep?

evening.he: גַּם אֶל זִקְנָה וְשֵׂיבָה אֱלֹהִים אַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי.
evening.en: Even to old age and grey hair, God, do not forsake me.
evening.reflect: What do you hope to still be doing in twenty years?

shabbatEve.reflect: Light the candles, pause, and say it out loud (your first words from lesson r04).

shabbatEve.en: The heavens and the earth and all their array were completed.
shabbatEve.reflect: What from the week do you leave unfinished on purpose?

shabbatEve.he: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ.
shabbatEve.en: God blessed the seventh day and made it holy.
shabbatEve.reflect: Who will you share a meal with tonight?

rosh-hashanah.en: Today the world is born anew.
rosh-hashanah.reflect: Name one habit you want to begin.
rosh-hashanah.source: Traditional liturgy (Rosh Hashanah Musaf line); wording recalled, NOT verified, provenance unchecked

yom-kippur.en: Before the Eternal you will be cleansed.
yom-kippur.reflect: Who will you ask forgiveness from?

sukkot.he: וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים.
sukkot.en: You shall rejoice before the Eternal your God seven days.
sukkot.reflect: Eat one meal outside this week.

hanukkah.he: לֹא בְחַיִל וְלֹא בְכֹחַ, כִּי אִם בְּרוּחִי.
hanukkah.en: Not by might and not by power, but by My spirit.
hanukkah.reflect: What small light can you add tonight?

tu-bishvat.he: וְהָיָה כְּעֵץ שָׁתוּל עַל פַּלְגֵי מָיִם.
tu-bishvat.en: He shall be like a tree planted by streams of water.
tu-bishvat.reflect: Plant, water or thank a tree.

purim.source: Esther 9:1 (public domain, partial verse; wording recalled, verify)

pesach.en: You shall tell your child on that day.
pesach.reflect: Tell one family story at the table.

shavuot.en: Your people shall be my people and your God my God.
shavuot.reflect: Who made you feel you belong?
